verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission will launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B in Florida (R2); Launch Pad 39B at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida (R3); at Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the launch location as LC-39B at Kennedy Space Center, Florida.

verifications.claim: The crewed Orion spacecraft will lift off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: NASA’s Artemis II SLS rocket, with the Orion spacecraft atop carrying NASA astronauts ... lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B (R2); Launching aboard the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket ... Launch Pad 39B (R3); Orion spacecraft ... at Launch Complex 39B (R4)
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly describes Orion atop SLS lifting off from LC-39B; supported by R3 and R4.

verifications.claim: Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center is used for Exploration Ground Systems.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Exploration Ground Systems, based at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, develops and operates the systems and facilities ... roll NASA’s Artemis II SLS ... out to Launch Pad 39B (R4)
verifications.reasoning: R4 associates Exploration Ground Systems at KSC with operations to LC-39B for Artemis, but does not explicitly state LC-39B 'is used for' EGS.

verifications.claim: Kennedy Space Center is located in Merritt Island, Florida.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions Merritt Island in connection with Kennedy Space Center.

verifications.claim: The launch pad for the Artemis 2 mission is Launch Complex 39B (LC-39B).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Launch Complex 39B (R2); Launch Pad 39B (R3); Launch Pad 39B (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm LC-39B as the launch pad for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission is a 10-day crewed lunar flyby.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon ... lunar flyby phase (R2); 10-day mission ... around the Moon (R3); Crewed Lunar Flyby ... 9 Days (actual), approx 10-day (R4)
verifications.reasoning: References consistently describe a ~10-day crewed mission around/flyby of the Moon.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 launch is aimed at testing deep space capabilities.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: first crewed deep-space flight ... test the systems ... test life-support systems and critical operations in deep space (R2); verify modern human capabilities in deep space (R3); first crewed flight aboard NASA’s human deep space capabilities (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of testing deep space operations and capabilities.

verifications.claim: There are viewing opportunities for the public along Florida's Space Coast for the Artemis 2 launch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Come View The Launch ... from Florida’s Space Coast ... Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex ... beach parks and piers ... best launch viewing locations (R1)
